recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future ShareableMeasure constraint or guidance work should happen in CRMI unless a new work-group decision explicitly reverses FHIR-48393 and returns the profile to core.
issue_request: FHIR-18234 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request from STU3 asking FHIR core to define a ShareableMeasure profile with shareable publishing metadata expectations including url, version, name, title, experimental, description, date, and publisher.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 01c412b836dcd45e9d67ed45c4e6a13846f13efa, which added the Measure shareable spreadsheet source. Later source history carried this forward as explicit ShareableMeasure StructureDefinition source and related Measure profile pack artifacts.
additional_context: Later applied issue FHIR-48393 resolved for R6 to remove profile definitions from the base specification and explicitly listed ShareableMeasure and PublishableMeasure as already moved to CRMI. Current core narrative in the Clinical Reasoning and Shareable pattern pages tells applications to use the CRMI profiles, and the active Measure example that needs a shareable profile declares the CRMI crmi-shareablemeasure profile.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source files were changed because the current absence of source/measure/structuredefinition-profile-shareablemeasure.xml is the intended result of FHIR-48393, not an unapplied FHIR-18234 gap.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision that removed ShareableMeasure and related shareable/publishable profiles from core because they had moved to CRMI.
